title: Slow-Cooker Hot Honey Chicken Sandwiches
changes_from_base: Thighs are rubbed with chilli, garlic, onion and two paprikas and slow-cooked with no added liquid, then shredded into spiced honey and cider vinegar and piled into toasted rolls with a lemony spring-onion slaw.
summary: Slow-cooked chicken thighs swimming in their own juices emerge impossibly tender, swathed in a warm coating of fiery honey and fresh cabbage slaw.

ingredients.item: dried chilli flakes, plus more to taste
fine sea salt or table salt
cider vinegar, plus more to taste
mayonnaise, plus extra for the buns
soft rolls or buns (onion rolls are good)

steps.title: Slow cook
steps.text: Put 900 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large slow cooker along with 15 ml vegetable oil, 1 tsp dried chilli flakes, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp sweet paprika, ¼ tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp fine salt and ½ tsp ground black pepper. Stir everything together well; no additional liquid is needed. Cover and cook on the low setting for 4-5 hours until the chicken is very tender and reaches 74 °C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Hot honey
steps.text: At any time before you plan to serve, stir 4 tbsp honey together with 1 tsp dried chilli flakes and ½ tsp garlic powder, then cover and leave at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional reduction
steps.text: If you like, lift the cooked chicken out of the slow cooker and simmer the cooking juices in a separate small pan until the volume has halved, then return the chicken to the cooker.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Use 2 forks to shred the cooked chicken into small, bite-sized pieces directly in the pot, mixing it with its cooking juices. Check that the thickest part reaches 74 °C. Stir in the spiced honey mixture and 2 tsp cider vinegar, then taste the chicken and add more salt, chilli flakes or vinegar if you prefer a stronger flavour.

steps.title: Slaw
steps.text: Toss together 225 g shredded green cabbage, 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 thinly sliced spring onions and 1 tbsp lemon juice in a medium bowl. Season to taste.

steps.title: Toast and assemble
steps.text: Split and toast 4 soft rolls or onion rolls if you like. Spread the insides with mayonnaise and a few shakes of vinegary hot sauce.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile the hot honey chicken onto the prepared rolls, top generously with the slaw and the bun lids.

tips: The chicken can stay on the warm setting for up to 3 hours after cooking, so you can prepare it ahead and keep it hot until you're ready to serve.
Make the hot honey mixture earlier in the day and leave it at room temperature; it melds together and tastes better than when first mixed.
Reduce the cooking juices if you like a more concentrated, savoury flavour against the sweet and spicy honey coating.
storage: Best served at once while the chicken is hot and the slaw is still crisp. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
